query: INSERT INTO messaging.spanish_switch (is_on, reviewed_on, reviewer, reviewed, note_on, note_reference, sample, changed_by, changed_at) SELECT $1, $2::text::date, $3, $4::jsonb, $5::text::date, $6, $7, $8, GREATEST($9, (SELECT max(changed_at) + interval '1 microsecond' FROM messaging.spanish_switch)) RETURNING id
